requirements.title: Approximately 100 SVG banners/infographics
requirements.meaning: Build a script, application, or workflow that generates approximately 100 SVG banners or infographic designs across different topics and categories.

requirements.title: Programmatic generation pipeline
requirements.meaning: The system should generate designs programmatically rather than requiring each banner to be manually created (topic, concept, copy, headings, supporting text, icons/illustrations, color, typography, layout, final SVG).
requirements.remainingWork: Demonstrate end-to-end on canonical collection with resolved provenance.

requirements.title: Topic/category content generation
requirements.meaning: Accept a topic, category, or content brief; generate suitable banner/infographic content with titles, subtitles, descriptions, key points; maintain hierarchy; avoid irrelevant/repetitive/grammatically incorrect content.
requirements.remainingWork: Canonical per-entry AI/fallback unknown — do not infer from historical aggregates.

requirements.title: Multiple design layouts
requirements.meaning: Generate multiple design layouts (promotional, educational, statistics, step-by-step, quote, announcement, comparison, feature highlights, list-based, corporate/social); output must not be the same layout with only text/color changed.

requirements.title: Valid scalable SVG files
requirements.meaning: Each output must be a valid, scalable SVG with dimensions/viewBox, text/typography, shapes/vectors, icons where relevant, spacing/alignment, contrast, responsive scaling where applicable, clean structure; viewable in browsers and vector tools.

requirements.title: Templates, styles, reusable components
requirements.meaning: Demonstrate multiple templates, visual styles, content structures, compositions; reusable components; configurable colors, fonts, spacing, dimensions; extensible without major code changes.
requirements.remainingWork: Manual review of meaningful variation across 100 outputs.

requirements.title: Original, professional, clean SVG
requirements.meaning: Designs must show intentional layouts, typography hierarchy, spacing, meaningful variation, relevant visuals; SVG must not contain prompt leakage, irrelevant metadata, hidden elements, scripts, broken defs; originality/IP rules apply.
requirements.remainingWork: Manual originality and visual professional review pending.

requirements.title: Meaningful AI in workflow
requirements.meaning: Demonstrate meaningful AI use (content, template selection, layout instructions, color/typography suggestions, structured elements, validation/refinement, variations). Simply calling an AI API and saving unstructured responses as SVG is not sufficient.
requirements.remainingWork: Resolve canonical collection provenance via Phase E.

requirements.title: ~100 SVG outputs with organization
requirements.meaning: Generate approximately 100 SVG outputs across topics/categories with design variation, generated content, consistent naming, organized folders; programmatic generation allowed but not simple duplicates with minor text/color changes.

requirements.title: Preview set and contact sheet
requirements.meaning: Submit ~100 SVGs, representative preview set of 10–15 designs, contact sheet or preview document if possible, source code, short technical report.
requirements.remainingWork: Refresh contact sheet after Phase E; expand preview count to 10–15 if needed.

requirements.title: Validation and quality checks
requirements.meaning: Validate SVG syntax, viewBox, required elements, text overflow, overlap, contrast, fonts/assets, broken references, duplicates, content completeness/relevance; automated or manual review.
requirements.remainingWork: Overlap/text overflow checks are heuristic only.

requirements.title: Source code and documentation
requirements.meaning: Submit complete source, configuration, dependency files, env documentation, run instructions; do not include private API keys.

requirements.title: Execution metrics report
requirements.meaning: Include total designs generated, successful outputs, failed/partial outputs, total time, average time per design, API/model usage, validation results, known limitations.
requirements.remainingWork: Regenerate after completed Phase E batch; stale interrupted runs must not imply success.

requirements.title: Evaluation criteria coverage
requirements.meaning: Review areas: Generative AI implementation, SVG generation, design quality, authenticity, variety, code quality, SVG cleanliness, originality, IP compliance, automation, validation, documentation.
requirements.remainingWork: Map each evaluation area to evidence in Requirements & Evidence view.
